name: Homecoming
text: Returning home after many years away: the changed house, old faces, being recognised or not.

passages.text: When a man returns safely after a long time spent abroad, family, friends, and loved ones celebrate his return.

Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one returns to his true home with honor.
